d: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect.
